scenario: A warehouse fire destroyed insured inventory worth $80,000. The policy was active, premiums were current, and fire is a listed covered peril. An inspection after the fire confirmed a sprinkler system was installed throughout the building.
policy: A commercial property policy covers fire loss to insured inventory. Coverage applies only if the business maintained its contractually required functioning sprinkler system at the time of loss; if the sprinkler system was inoperative at the time of loss, the fire loss is excluded.
question: Is the fire loss to inventory covered?
